hook.en: Every grain of rice you eat began as carbon dioxide in the air. Melvin Calvin used radioactive carbon to trace exactly how a leaf builds sugar from it.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ತಿನ್ನುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಕಾಳು ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಡೈಆಕ್ಸೈಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು. ಮೆಲ್ವಿನ್ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ವಿನ್ ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಬಳಸಿ ಎಲೆ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.

objectives.en: Identify the primary CO₂ acceptor and the first stable product in C₃ plants.
Calculate ATP and NADPH needed per CO₂ and per glucose.

narration.en: Every grain of rice you eat began as carbon dioxide in the air. Melvin Calvin used radioactive carbon to trace exactly how a leaf builds sugar from it.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ತಿನ್ನುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಕಾಳು ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಡೈಆಕ್ಸೈಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು. ಮೆಲ್ವಿನ್ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ವಿನ್ ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಬಳಸಿ ಎಲೆ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.

body.en: ATP and NADPH from the light reaction are used in the stroma to fix CO₂ into carbohydrate. Using radioactive ¹⁴C in algae, Melvin Calvin found that the first CO₂ fixation product is a 3-carbon organic acid, 3-phosphoglyceric acid (PGA); plants in which this happens are C₃ plants. The primary CO₂ acceptor is the 5-carbon ketose sugar ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP). The cycle has three stages. Carboxylation: CO₂ is fixed to RuBP by the enzyme RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase (RuBisCO), giving two molecules of 3-PGA; this is the most crucial step. Reduction: using 2 ATP and 2 NADPH per CO₂ fixed, PGA is reduced to triose phosphate, and glucose is formed. Regeneration: RuBP is regenerated so the cycle continues, using 1 ATP per CO₂.

points.en: Primary acceptor: RuBP (5C); first stable product: 3-PGA (3C).

The primary CO₂ acceptor is the 5-carbon ketose sugar ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP). The cycle has three stages. Carboxylation: CO₂ is fixed to RuBP by the enzyme RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase (RuBisCO), giving two molecules of 3-PGA; this is the most crucial step. Reduction: using 2 ATP and 2 NADPH per CO₂ fixed, PGA is reduced to triose phosphate, and glucose is formed. Regeneration: RuBP is regenerated so the cycle continues, using 1 ATP per CO₂.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ವಿನ್ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಬಾಕ್ಸಿಲೀಕರಣ, ಅಪಕರ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ. RuBP ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರಕ, 3-PGA ಮೊದಲ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ. ಒಂದು CO₂ ಗೆ 3 ATP ಮತ್ತು 2 NADPH ಬೇಕು.

title.en: Counting the cost of one glucose

body.en: One glucose has six carbons, so six CO₂ must be fixed and the cycle must turn six times. Each turn uses 3 ATP and 2 NADPH, so one glucose needs 18 ATP and 12 NADPH. The cyclic flow of electrons helps meet the extra ATP demand, since non-cyclic flow alone gives ATP and NADPH in roughly equal amounts.

narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ಗೆ ಆರು ಬಾರಿ ಚಕ್ರ ತಿರುಗಬೇಕು; 18 ATP ಮತ್ತು 12 NADPH ಬೇಕು.

problem.en: How many ATP and NADPH molecules are needed to make 3 molecules of glucose by the Calvin cycle? How many turns of the cycle does this take?

steps.en: One glucose needs 6 CO₂, i.e. 6 turns, 18 ATP and 12 NADPH.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. How many ATP and NADPH molecules are needed to make 3 molecules of glucose by the Calvin cycle? How many turns of the cycle does this take?

body.en: For every CO₂ fixed: 3 ATP (2 for reduction + 1 for regeneration) and 2 NADPH. Multiply by 6 for glucose: 18 and 12.

narration.en: The 3-2-1 of one CO₂. For every CO₂ fixed: 3 ATP (2 for reduction + 1 for regeneration) and 2 NADPH. Multiply by 6 for glucose: 18 and 12.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Per CO₂: 3 ATP + 2 NADPH; per glucose: 18 ATP + 12 NADPH.

homework.en: Draw the Calvin cycle showing its three stages and where ATP and NADPH are used.

narration.en: Recap. RuBP + CO₂ → 2 × 3-PGA, catalysed by RuBisCO. Three stages: carboxylation, reduction, regeneration. Per CO₂: 3 ATP + 2 NADPH; per glucose: 18 ATP + 12 NADPH.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. RuBP + CO₂ → 2 × 3-PGA, ರುಬಿಸ್ಕೊ ವೇಗವರ್ಧನೆ. ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳು: ಕಾರ್ಬಾಕ್ಸಿಲೀಕರಣ, ಅಪಕರ್ಷಣ, ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದನೆ. ಒಂದು CO₂ ಗೆ 3 ATP + 2 NADPH; ಒಂದು ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ಗೆ 18 ATP + 12 NADPH.
